title: Dimension Capital's $800M Fund Signals Science-Compute Boom
excerpt: Dimension Capital has raised $800 million for its third fund, a 60% increase from its previous fund announced 18 months earlier. The investment underscores surging investor appetite for startups at the intersection of biology and computation, particularly in AI-driven biotech. This fund marks a key milestone for the four-year-old firm and the broader science-compute convergence.
description: Dimension Capital's $800M third fund (60% increase) signals soaring investor appetite for AI-driven biotech and the convergence of science and computation.
